# Bisendra Melaram

> Bisendra Melaram, Team Leader of Keller Williams Greater Nassau in Garden City, NY, and a seller's agent on Long Island's South Shore. Licensed Real Estate Salesperson since 2003. He mainly lists and sells homes, and also represents buyers, across Long Island, with a focus on the South Shore of Nassau County (Valley Stream, Lynbrook, Rockville Centre, Oceanside, Baldwin, Freeport), sellers 50 and older, and South Asian families.

Office: Keller Williams Greater Nassau, 400 Garden City Plaza, Suite 438, Garden City, NY 11530. Phone 516-873-7100.

- [Sellers](https://bisendramelaram.com/sellers/): pricing, preparation and New York's 2024 disclosure rules
- [Buyers](https://bisendramelaram.com/buyers/): buying on the South Shore, flood zones, buyer agreements
- [Seniors and downsizing](https://bisendramelaram.com/seniors-downsizing/): SRES help for clients 50+
